entities.name: Nathaniel P. Langford
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Nathaniel Pitt Langford was an American explorer, businessman, bureaucrat, vigilante, and historian from Saint Paul, Minnesota who played an important role in the early years of the Montana gold fields, territorial government and the creation of Yellowstone National Park.
